explication: Surfingkeys is a keyboard-driven browser extension. A user presses a mapping on a web page; the extension interprets it through its mode and hint systems, then presents a result such as navigation, search, or a browser action. The graph also includes its omnibar, settings, LLM chat and tools, and Neovim-style editor integration. Some feature branches are documented in the README but their internal wiring is unsampled; those relationships are shown only where the README or excerpts support them.
